general.label: Everyday sentences
sentences: Could you please tell me where the nearest bus stop is?
I usually wake up at seven and have breakfast with my family.
Thank you so much for your help yesterday.
I would like to book a table for two people tonight.
What time does the meeting start tomorrow morning?

th.label: TH sounds (think / this)
sentences: I think this is the third time this month.
Thank you for thinking of them.
My brother and father both thought the weather was great.
There are three things I want to mention.

v_w.label: V and W sounds (very / west)
sentences: We visited a very beautiful village in the west.
Would you like to watch a video with us?
Victor waited while Wendy wrote the invitation.

r_l.label: R and L sounds (right / light)
sentences: Turn right at the light near the library.
Please read the rules really carefully.
Larry learned to play the violin last year.

endings.label: Word endings (-ed, -s)
sentences: She worked hard and finished all her tasks.
He likes books, maps and old photographs.
We walked to the park and talked for hours.

interview.label: Interview phrases
sentences: I have two years of experience in software development.
One of my strengths is that I communicate clearly with my team.
I am looking for an opportunity to grow and learn new skills.
Could you tell me more about the team I would be working with?
